# Contributing to Python Chess Game ♟️

First off, thank you for considering contributing to this project! 🎉  
Contributions of all kinds — code, documentation, bug reports, or ideas — are very welcome.

---

## 📌 How to Contribute

### 1️⃣ Fork the Repository
Click the **Fork** button at the top-right of this repository.

### 2️⃣ Clone Your Fork
```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/Chess.git
cd Chess
````

### 3️⃣ Create a Feature Branch

```bash
git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name
```

Use clear branch names, for example:

* `feature/move-history-panel`
* `fix/ai-crash-on-start`

---

### 4️⃣ Make Your Changes

* Follow existing code style and structure
* Keep changes focused and minimal
* Test your changes thoroughly

---

### 5️⃣ Commit Your Changes

```bash
git commit -m "Add move history panel with notation"
```

**Commit message tips:**

* Use present tense (`Add`, not `Added`)
* Be descriptive but concise

---

### 6️⃣ Push and Open a Pull Request

```bash
git push origin feature/your-feature-name
```

Then open a **Pull Request** on GitHub.

---

## 🧩 What You Can Work On

* Issues labeled **`good first issue`** are beginner-friendly
* Issues labeled **`help wanted`** may require deeper understanding
* UI/UX improvements
* Cross-platform support (macOS / Linux)
* AI and analysis features

If unsure, feel free to comment on an issue before starting 👍

---

## 🧪 Testing Guidelines

Before submitting a PR:

* Test in **VS AI** and **Pass & Play** modes
* Test special moves (castling, en passant, promotion)
* Verify no crashes at different AI ELO levels

---

## 🎨 Code Style Guidelines

* Use clear, descriptive variable and function names
* Prefer small, focused functions
* Add comments only where logic is non-obvious
* Use type hints where applicable

---

## 🚦 Pull Request Checklist

Please ensure:

* [ ] Code runs without errors
* [ ] No existing functionality is broken
* [ ] UI changes are visually tested
* [ ] Related documentation is updated if needed

---

## 💬 Need Help?

If you’re stuck or unsure:

* Ask questions directly on the issue
* Open a draft PR for discussion
* Suggest alternative approaches — ideas are welcome!

Thank you for helping make this project better 💙
